name: Max Elam
paragraphs: Faith comes first for me. I enjoy drawing for others, skateboarding, spending time in nature, dogs, reading, and exercise. Humility, healing, and bringing hope to others matter to me.
I came to Hope House Guthrie during a financial crisis while struggling with alcohol. I lost my job and was evicted on the same day. I spent a week sleeping in my car, but I kept trying to find help.
At Hope House Guthrie, I found a bed, regular meals, and a safe place where I could feel at peace. The house leaders are genuine, caring, and real.

I'm proud that I'm not drinking, and I feel closer to God. My goals seem a little clearer every day. I'm working to better myself so I can help others. Thank you to everyone who supports Hope House Guthrie.
quote: I am proud to not be drinking. Also, feeling closer to God and my goals seem a little clearer every day.
